name: Vessel colors
notes: The little vessel, its shade, the Void Bolt spell and the hit / soul sparks. 1 = void black outline, 2 = mask white, 3 = mask shade, 4-6 = cloak (dark to light), 7-8 = nail silver, 9 = slash white, a-b = slash blue, c-d = void purple (dash trail, shade, spell), e-f = soul glow.
